data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — infrastructure RED-test task. DD ownership for dd-2 is held by task-2b, which makes this test pass. This task establishes the failing behavioral contract first per RED-before-GREEN discipline.)

Create tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh asserting the not-yet-existing hook's contract: (1) trailer absent under .fix-bug-active marker → exit non-zero; (2) trailer present, matches=0 → exit 0; (3) matches>0 with NO follow-up artifact → exit non-zero; (4) matches>0 satisfied by ticket id in trailer OR a match file in the cached diff OR a '# antipattern-ok: <reason>' annotation in {different-context, dead-code, already-tracked:<id>} → exit 0; (5) the antipattern-ok annotation is capped at 3/session (4th → exit non-zero); (6) no .fix-bug-active marker → exit 0 (never gates other skills). The test MUST fail now because plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh does not yet exist. Set the executable bit on the new test file.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh
- [ ] Test is RED now (fails because hook is absent) — Verify: ! bash tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh
- [ ] Test asserts trailer-absent refusal, matches>0 follow-up requirement, the 3 follow-up artifact forms, the 3/session annotation cap, and the no-marker pass-through — Verify: for t in trailer-absent matches follow-up antipattern-ok 'cap' fix-bug-active; do grep -q "$t" tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh || { echo MISSING:$t; exit 1; }; done

## TDD Test Approach
Given the .fix-bug-active marker is present and a commit message with no Antipattern-Scan trailer; When tests/hooks/test-check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh invokes plugins/dso/hooks/check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh against that message; Then the hook exits non-zero (trailer-absent refusal) — and the test currently FAILS because the hook script does not yet exist.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Write RED test for check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh (fails because hook absent)
